constraints.explanation: The path must start exactly at the specified start position and end exactly at the specified goal position.
All waypoints must lie within the rectangular map boundaries: [0, width] x [0, height].
Every waypoint must maintain a minimum Euclidean distance from each obstacle center, at least the sum of the obstacle radius and the safety distance.
All waypoint coordinates must be finite real numbers.
The number of waypoints in the path must not exceed the maximum specified by max_waypoints.

description: Static 2D UAV path planning problem in a bounded environment with obstacles and risk zones. The UAV must find a feasible path from start to goal, represented as ordered 2D waypoints, that avoids obstacles by at least the safety distance, stays within map bounds, has a limited number of waypoints, and minimizes a weighted combination of path length, collision penalty, smoothness, risk exposure, and waypoint count. Risk zones are soft costs and never hard obstacles.
objective: Minimize the configured weighted sum of total polyline length, one collision penalty per colliding path segment, the sum of squared normalized unsigned turn angles, zone-weighted path-segment length inside rectangular risk zones, and the number of intermediate waypoints. Risk zones are soft costs and never hard obstacles.
output: Return a feasible start-to-goal path as ordered 2D waypoints.
